name: @pipeworx/mcp-smithsonian

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Smithsonian Open Access collection by keyword. Returns matching items with ids (pass an id to object), titles, creators, dates and image links.

_apiKey.description: Smithsonian Open Access API key (auto-injected by the platform; or pass your own).

tools.name: object
tools.description: Fetch full details for one Smithsonian Open Access item by id — a Smithsonian content id (the "id" field from search).

_apiKey.description: Smithsonian Open Access API key (auto-injected by the platform; or pass your own).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-smithsonian forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the smithsonian pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
